reasoning: The icon combines a document with text lines and a broadcasting speaker, clearly conveying text-to-speech, read-aloud articles, voiceover scripts, or audiobooks. It fits tasks centered on spoken text or listening to written material, though at very small sizes the page frame could be overlooked and mistaken for a plain speaker icon.
